==Gameplay==
{| class="floatright"
|[[File:Last Man Standing Desert Island map.png|200px|center|thumb|A map of Desert Island with marked locations]]
|[[File:Last Man Standing Wild Varrock map.png|200px|center|thumb|A map of Wild Varrock with marked locations]]
|}
At the start of the game, a map is chosen from the map pool at random. Currently there are two island maps available (Desert Island and Wild Varrock), with a 50% chance of either being chosen.

Players can indicate their preferred account build via a Settings button on the screen when in the lobby. There are three different account builds: Max/Med, Zerker, and 1 Def Pure. Upon arrival to the island, the same account build is randomly chosen for all players, with a higher chance given to builds preferred by more players in the waiting area.

All prayers (excluding [[Rapid Restore]], [[Rapid Heal]], [[Protect Item]], [[Retribution]], [[Redemption]], [[Smite]] and [[Preserve]], and excluding [[Rigour]], [[Augury]], [[Piety]] and [[Chivalry]] for the Zerker and 1 Def Pure builds) can be used. In addition, players are given infinite [[run energy]] as well as infinite [[prayer]]. The player does not need to complete [[Desert Treasure I]] to cast [[Ancient Magicks]] or [[Lunar Diplomacy]] to use the [[Lunar spellbook]]. Once the player arrives, the game will begin in 12 seconds.

Upon killing an opponent, the player's health, run energy, [[special attack]] and supplies are all replenished. If an opponent logs out before they are killed, the game will consider the attacker to have killed their opponent. Players will also receive a [[bloody key]] (or a [[bloodier key]] if there are fewer than six players remaining), which they should use on a [[Chest (Last Man Standing)|chest]] to receive more powerful equipment. During this time, players are also unattackable for 20 seconds, giving them time to find a chest to loot as well as preparing for the next fight against another player.

Items found within the island have different [[item IDs]] than their normal counterparts. If players somehow were able to smuggle these items outside the minigame and attempt to use them, they would disappear instantly.

Players can logout or use the [[rowboat (Last Man Standing)|rowboats in Desert Island]] to forfeit a game. Players forfeiting will not receive any rewards. Forfeiting three times a day will ban that player from playing Competitive or High Stakes for the rest of the day.

[[File:Last Man Standing supply chest setup.png|thumb|250px|Players can arrange their inventory and equipment loadout at the [[supply chest]] near Lisa.]]
The [[supply chest]] just west of Lisa allows players to arrange their inventory, equipment loadout, and [[spellbook]] to their personal preference.
Players can choose between the [[Standard Spellbook]], [[Ancient Magicks]] and [[Lunar Spellbook]] in the supply chest, giving access to the [[Surge spell]]s and [[Entangle]], Ice and Blood [[Blitz spells|Blitz]] and [[Barrage spells]], and [[Vengeance]] and [[Cure Me]] respectively. The Lunar Spellbook cannot be activated for 1 Def Pure builds.
Players are given a default set of items for the account type they selected. This includes [[Super restore (Last Man Standing)|super restore]], [[Super combat potion (Last Man Standing)|super combat potion]], [[Saradomin brew]], [[ranging potion]], and a unique [[Rune pouch (Last Man Standing)|rune pouch]] that gives access to the spells mentioned previously.
A player's supplies are limited to 10 sharks, 3 Saradomin brews, 2 Sanfew serums, and 1 each of every other potion for their loadout, and slain opponents do not drop their supplies for the player to pick up. 

To improve their chance of survival, players must loot [[Chest (Last Man Standing)|chests]] throughout the island with [[bloody key]]s and [[bloodier key]]s. Chests opened with bloody keys will roll for an item from two loot tables, one of which contains offensive gear, and the other defensive, while bloodier keys access an upgraded offensive loot table.

[[File:Last Man Standing loot crate.png|thumb|280px|A loot crate that occasionally spawns in a broadcasted location.]]
There will also be [[crate (Last Man Standing)|loot crates]] that may spawn throughout the map; the chat box will broadcast its location to all remaining players. On the Desert Island map, loot crates spawn in random locations. On Wild Varrock, loot crates will always spawn close to the safe zone. These loot crates can roll on the upgraded loot table.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1356691744826548232|date=2 February 2021|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/97684|archivedate=30 March 2023}}

===Fog===
[[File:Last Man Standing fog.png|thumb|The fog begins to settle in, damaging any player in its vicinity.]]
After a minute, the game will broadcast that lethal fog will soon fill the island, and the safe zone that players must travel to, in order to avoid damage from the fog, which will be indicated by [[fog marker]]s (appearing as glowing orbs) and a yellow arrow.

After 2 minutes and 30 seconds, greater fog will activate. Players less than 16 tiles into the fog will take 1-3 damage every other tick, ramping up over 6 ticks. Players 16 or more tiles into the fog will be subject to greater fog, which can deal up to 10 damage every other tick.

Players who aren't in the safe zone after 10 minutes will take rapid damage, beginning at approximately 1 damage per tick, but steadily increasing to 10 damage per tick.
